name: 1. Rice-Oriented Delta Region (Kharif Monsoon)
description: High-rainfall, humid coastal delta with clay loam soil, representative of Godavari/Krishna/Cauvery or Bengal plains during Kharif.
expected_outcome: Rice (Oryza sativa) should achieve top compatibility (>85%). Drought-tolerant crops like Pearl Millet and Chickpea should register significant climate/season mismatches.

name: 2. Millet-Oriented Semi-Arid Zone (Dryland Kharif)
description: Low-rainfall, sandy loam dryland in western India (Rajasthan/Gujarat) with warm temperatures and low humidity.
expected_outcome: Pearl Millet (Bajra) and Sorghum should rank at the top (>85%). Water-intensive crops (Rice, Sugarcane) should be flagged as severe mismatches.

name: 3. Pulse-Oriented Cool Winter Zone (Rabi Central India)
description: Cool winter climate in Madhya Pradesh/Maharashtra on vertisol black soil with low residual winter moisture.
expected_outcome: Chickpea (Bengal Gram) and Wheat should achieve highest suitability. Kharif-specific crops (Pigeon Pea, Rice, Cotton) will show season incompatibility.

name: 4. Missing NPK Soil Lab Data (Kharif Deccan Plateau)
description: Farmer has basic field observations (Black soil, warm monsoon climate) but has not yet conducted laboratory soil NPK testing.
expected_outcome: The engine excludes NPK weights from the score denominator, reports ~70% data coverage, and evaluates Cotton, Soybean, and Maize without penalizing missing soil test kits.

name: 5. Conflicting or Insufficient Information
description: Only state and season provided, with soil type unknown, missing pH, missing rainfall, and extreme temperature (47°C).
expected_outcome: Engine detects data coverage is well below minimum 35% threshold and flags an Insufficient Data advisory with a list of missing essential factors.
